entities.name: PPP1R26
observations: The 768-aa query matched reviewed Mus musculus PPP1R26 (UniProt Q6A025) at 100% identity and 100% query coverage.
Reviewed PPP1R26 annotation: inhibits protein phosphatase 1 (PP1) complexes; reported nuclear and nucleolar localization and interactions with UTP20 and PPP1CA.
The query has a PPP1R26_N Pfam match spanning residues 1–767; predicted mass 82.9 kDa, pI 8.64, GRAVY −0.862, instability index 71.75.
